description: This file defines the Customer class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages customer-related operations such as login, logout, retrieving customer details, and interacting with the database.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents a customer in the Opencart system, providing methods for authentication, retrieving customer data, and managing session state.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Customer object, loads customer data from session if available.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a customer with email and password, manages session data.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current customer, clearing session and customer data.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Checks if a customer is currently logged in.

methods.name: getNewsletter
methods.description: Indicates if the customer is subscribed to the newsletter.

methods.name: isSafe
methods.description: Indicates if the customer is marked as safe.

methods.name: isCommenter
methods.description: Indicates if the customer has commenter privileges.

methods.name: getAddressId
methods.description: Retrieves the default address ID for the customer.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the customer's total balance.

methods.name: getRewardPoints
methods.description: Calculates and returns the customer's total reward points.
